title: Minutes to Seconds
statement:
Turn a number of minutes into seconds. Every minute has 60 seconds.

The input is one whole number `minutes`, zero or more. Print the number of seconds in that many minutes.

Input:

```text
5
```

Expected output:

```text
300
```

python.solution:
def minutes_to_seconds(minutes: int) -> int:
    return minutes * 60


minutes = int(input())
print(minutes_to_seconds(minutes))
